scope: B4.3 active-run device disconnect, Windows Worker restart, execution convergence, device lease recovery, immediate reuse, and bounded stability

device_disconnect.scope_note: The failure was injected after the first real device step passed; the run did not report a false pass while ADB was unavailable.

pre_fix_worker_restart.finding: Execution recovery did not release the Android device lease, blocking later runs until the independent device lease expired.

fix.behavior: For an abandoned Android case run, recovery finds the exact case-run owner label, locks Device before re-reading DeviceLease, deletes the lease, restores a busy device to online, and records execution_recovery in the run summary.
fix.review: The first implementation depended on the case's current device_serial. Review changed it to the immutable case-run owner label so an edit during execution cannot redirect cleanup.

post_fix_worker_restart.error_message: Execution worker heartbeat expired; the run was recovered as failed.

verification.windows_temp_retry: The first full run had 54 setup errors from WinError 5 on the default pytest temp root; an isolated writable TEMP/TMP full rerun had no test failures.

scope_note: This closes the B4 single-device release scope. Optional multi-device lease conflicts and compatibility matrices remain non-blocking; C1 observability and production performance remain separate.
